trigger_evals.query: Audit the Agent Plugin at agent-plugin/cao and tell me whether every skill is inside the Agent Skills limits.
cao plugin validate says my package is loadable. Does that mean its skills meet the 1024-character description limit?
Check this package's plugin.json manifest against the vendored schema and list every finding by severity.
Run the skills-limits gate over skills/ and report any skill whose body is over 500 lines.
Is this Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package conformant? It has a mcp.json and three skills.
Why does cao plugin validate --json exit 1 with nothing on stdout when I audit my package?
Does the manifest description of this Agent Plugin line up with the skills it actually ships?
Build a CAO event plugin that writes an audit log line every time a message is delivered.
How do CAO event plugins hook into status_changed and session_created events?
Create a brand-new Agent Plugin with a plugin.json and one skill from an empty directory.
Review my client-specific agent plugin before I migrate it to the portable structure.
Recall what we stored in CAO memory about the preferred test runner.
Send a follow-up message to the running supervisor session.

evals.prompt: Audit agent-plugin/cao-contributor and tell me if it is conformant.
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled validator in package mode with uv run --script, reports its exit status and summary line verbatim, and separately reports CAO's own verdict only when CAO_AGENT_PLUGINS_ENABLED is set inline.
assertions: Runs scripts/validate_agent_plugin.py with the package root as the positional argument
Reports the exit status and the summary line
Reports the bundled validator's result and CAO's verdict separately
States that CAO does not enforce the name pattern, the 1024-character limit or the 500-line limit, and at most warns about them
Does not claim CAO rejects an over-limit skill

evals.prompt: Check every skill in this repository's skills/ directory against the Agent Skills limits.
evals.expected_output: Uses --skills-dir skills/ rather than the positional form, and explains that skills/plugin.json and children without a SKILL.md are ignored in that mode.
assertions: Explains that skills/ is not an Agent Plugin root because skills/plugin.json has no $schema
States that a top-level plugin.json and children without a SKILL.md are ignored
Interprets exit 0 as no finding above advisory, 1 as findings, and anything else as an audit failure

evals.prompt: This package's description says it ships three skills but the audit lists one. Did the audit detect a mismatch?
evals.expected_output: An explanation that the description listing is an advisory that prints the declared description beside the discovered skills for a human to compare, and that the audit makes no judgement about meaning.
assertions: States that the advisory never changes the exit status
States that the audit does not judge whether the description and the skills correspond
